title: May Wrong Choices Path Inventory
preFlightTestResult: 225/225 PASS (119 Stage C + 86 tutoring safety + 20 governance guard)
methodology: Direct source-code inspection of may-core.js, test_may_stagec.js, test_tutoring_safety.js

primaryMethod.name: _explainWrongChoices
primaryMethod.description: Generates wrong-choice output. Iterates non-correct choices, includes bank ExplanationWrong fields if >10 chars, otherwise uses generic fallback.

currentBehavior: Skips correct choice (CC) — only outputs wrong options A/C/D when CC=B
For each wrong option with ExplanationWrong > 10 chars: displays 'Option X — choice text' + one-line ExplanationWrong
For each wrong option with thin/missing ExplanationWrong: displays generic 'This choice is incorrect' + topic mention
No selected-answer prioritization — always presents options in alphabetical order
No answer-gating — does not check if learner has attempted the question
No review-mode distinction — same behavior in active session and review mode
No misconception coaching — repeats ExplanationWrong verbatim without context
Routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode, _speak in non-pilot
Handles items with no choices gracefully

gating.nullQuestion: Graceful — 'I don't have a question to work with' message
gating.noChoices: Graceful — suggests using Explain answer instead
gating.activeUnanswered: NO GATE — _explainWrongChoices does not check if learner has attempted
gating.reviewMode: No distinction — same output as active session

callers.gating: Exam mode blocked by handleAction before call

callers.trigger: 'why is X wrong/incorrect/not' pattern in learner message
callers.gating: No exam-mode check in freeform path (handleAction not called)

learnerAnswerAccess.note: Available to _explainWrongChoices if it reads window.state directly

guardedSpeakIntegration.safetyContext: _guardedTutoringContext() at line 4173 — includes correctChoice, correctAnswer, examModeActive, hintLevel, allowPatterns

stageC.assertions: Verifies each non-CC option letter appears in output
stageC.updateTo: Verify structured coaching output with misconception sections

tutoringSafety.reason: All wrong options must still appear, just with richer content

missingFeatures: No misconception coaching structure (why tempting, why wrong, misconception, how to avoid)
No safe-fallback when ExplanationWrong is thin
safetyPreserved: No prediction language in current output

implementationPlan.helperPurpose: Builds structured misconception coaching for each wrong choice using ExplanationWrong + inference
implementationPlan.answerGatingLogic: Check for active unanswered question BEFORE revealing which options are wrong
implementationPlan.selectedAnswerPrioritization: If learner has selected a wrong answer, present that option first
implementationPlan.reviewModeBehavior: Allow full coaching with review-mode-specific framing
